name: Avocado / Butter Fruit
title: Avocado / Butter Fruit
description: The avocado plant is a tropical evergreen tree belonging to the Lauraceae family. While it can grow into a massive canopy tree in the wild, its structural elements make it a fascinating study for plant biology projects.
care: Light: Bright, direct sunlight,+ Watering: Water deeply but infrequently,+ Soil: Loose, sandy, and well-draining.
